description: Find Best Of Motivation articles that answer a question about leadership, managing a team, habits, productivity, personal growth, money or using AI at work. Use when the user asks for practical advice on these topics or asks what Best Of Motivation says about something. Returns up to 5 articles with title, URL, summary and the most relevant excerpt. Do not use it when the user wants to take a quiz: use the matching start_*_quiz tool instead.

limit.description: How many articles to return (1-5). Default 3.

query.description: The user's question or topic in plain words, e.g. 'how to give feedback to a defensive employee'.

name: search_bom_articles
title: Search Best Of Motivation articles
